name: IRIS — Market: Macro Daily
description: Daily 11:15 UTC. One fredgraph.csv request per series (10) with a declared User-Agent (FRED tarpits anonymous requests); written via iris_inv_series; every run reported to iris.feed_health ('macro'), 0 rows = failure.

parameters.content:
## FRED macro, one request per series
Multi-id fredgraph URLs return a ZIP and silently ignore cosd, so each series gets its own request, throttled to one every 500ms.
The series id is read back out of the CSV header (column 2), so rows cannot be mislabelled by request ordering.
FRED ignores cosd on some monthly series (CPIAUCSL returns 1947-to-date), so the parser keeps only the last 45 valid observations per series.
Catalyst rule: WTI +/-4% or DGS10 +/-15bp versus the value 5 trading days earlier. No move, no catalyst row, no request.

nodes.name: Report Feed Run

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_token: "<<IRIS_TOKEN>>", p_feed: "macro", p_ok: ((($json.body || {}).rows || 0) > 0), p_rows: (($json.body || {}).rows || 0), p_error: (((($json.body || {}).rows || 0) > 0) ? null : ("0 macro rows written; series skipped: " + JSON.stringify($('Parse Macro CSV').first().json.seriesSkipped || []) + "; write status " + $json.statusCode)), p_source_ref: ("n8n:x67We2CrO8FYwJuL:" + $execution.id), p_meta: { series_parsed: $('Parse Macro CSV').first().json.seriesParsed, series_skipped: $('Parse Macro CSV').first().json.seriesSkipped, catalysts: ($('Parse Macro CSV').first().json.catalysts || []).length } }) }}

nodes.notes: iris.feed_health 'macro': ok only when the write reported rows > 0; otherwise the skipped-series list becomes the error text.
